runs.text: Thirty three votes. Did they make a country? November twenty nine, one thousand nine hundred and forty seven. The U.N. votes on splitting British ruled Palestine in two. One Jewish state. One Arab state. And Jerusalem, under the U.N. Thirty three countries vote yes. Even the United States and the Soviet Union agree. Thirteen vote no. Among them, every Arab member state. Ten abstain. Britain, the ruling power, is one of them. Jewish leaders accept the plan. Arab leaders reject it. Violence starts almost at once. Six months later, full war. That war cost both peoples dearly. Hundreds of thousands of Palestinian Arabs became refugees. Was partition the right call? Tell me below. And it all came down to thirty three votes.
